issues.where: pale flyer above the right-hand shallows, frames 1241–1252
issues.what: the wings snap from raised to a broad low fan and back in a handful of adjacent frames; the body barely answers the stroke
issues.fix: space the wing poses through the stroke and let the body react to lift before the next beat

issues.where: foreground feeding animal and its contact with the water, frames 1730–1866; confirmed close up in set-A-09.png
issues.what: the camera closes in while the animal holds a rigid neck and leg pose; the white contact effect stays the same fan of streaks and beads instead of breaking into the pool
issues.fix: animate weight changes and small interruptions in the feeding action, and give each contact a short splash that falls back and sends out ripples

issues.where: incoming wave between the rock walls, especially frames 2429–2506
issues.what: the wave arrives across the channel, but its face grows into a nearly vertical striped curtain; the foam stretches down it instead of pitching forward and breaking under its own weight
issues.fix: carry a coherent wall forward, roll the crest over the face, then let broken foam and run-up spread around the foreground rocks

issues.where: foreground at the ocean-to-shallows approach, frames 757–946
issues.what: the moving chop gives way to a nearly mirror-flat surface with a sharp change in the appearance of the water
issues.fix: let the swell flatten gradually over the shallows and carry smaller ripples and breaking edges through the transition

issues.where: perched animals across the terraces, frames 1517–1651; close detail in set-A-10.png
issues.what: many of the animals hold the same bent silhouette as the view travels past, so the colony reads as repeated posed models beneath the moving flyers
issues.fix: vary the resting poses and stagger small head turns, foot resets and wing folds across the ledges

issues.where: close flyer crossing from the left cliff toward the right, frames 1867–2022
issues.what: the flyer travels a long way with its wings held almost rigid and little banking or body response
issues.fix: shape the glide with subtle wing flex and banking tied to the flight path
